summary_en: €351M (~¥65.2B) tender offer for 100% of AUSTRIACARD HOLDINGS AG closed 26 August 2026 with 96.55% acceptance (35.1M shares tendered). Completion conditional on Austrian FDI clearance; as of 25 August, Greek, Romanian FDI and Austrian, German, Turkish competition approvals obtained. Upon Austrian clearance, squeeze-out under Austrian law to achieve 100% ownership planned. Dai Nippon Printing to become majority investor at €10.0/share.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for Shares of Austrian Listed Company AUSTRIACARD HOLDINGS AG
translation_en_brief: Dai Nippon Printing announced on 26 August 2026 the successful close of its tender offer for all ordinary shares of AUSTRIACARD HOLDINGS AG, an Austrian-listed manufacturer of payment cards, ID cards, and security printing products operating across Europe, Africa, and North America. The offer ran from 12 June to 21 August 2026 and closed with 35,099,096 shares tendered, representing 96.55% acceptance—exceeding the 75% minimum threshold required for completion. The offer price was €10.0 per share (inclusive of dividends), for a total consideration of approximately €351 million (approximately ¥65.2 billion, converted at the July 2026 average TTM rate of ¥185.66 per euro). As of 25 August 2026, Dai Nippon has obtained FDI clearance from Greece and Romania and competition law approval from Austria, Germany, and Turkey; however, Austrian FDI clearance remains pending. Upon receipt of that final clearance, all completion conditions will be satisfied and the offer will become effective, making AUSTRIACARD a consolidated subsidiary. Thereafter, Dai Nippon intends to execute a squeeze-out under Austrian law to achieve 100% ownership. The target company manufactures payment and national ID solutions and variable security printing and generated FY2025 revenue of €360.2 million with net profit of €14.7 million.
